title: Top 5 BIGGEST Stars In The Universe
hook: Number one is so vast our Sun looks microscopic beside it.

items.name: Antares
items.stat: 700 times the Sun's radius and 10,000 times brighter

items.name: Betelgeuse
items.stat: 760 times the Sun — it would swallow Mars's orbit

items.name: VY Canis Majoris
items.stat: A hypergiant about 1,400 times the Sun's radius

items.name: WOH G64
items.stat: 1,540 times the Sun's radius, shrouded in thick dust

items.name: Stephenson 2-18
items.stat: 2,150 times the Sun — 10 billion Suns fit inside
